_comment: Segmentation profiles. 'adaptive_*' profiles scale with the well size (fractions of the well side); classical profiles use fixed pixel values tuned BY EYE on the three original example images. None is validated against researcher-approved masks. Profiles describe image appearance, not filenames.

adaptive_sparse.description: Scale-aware adaptive segmenter (illumination correction + per-well robust dark/texture thresholds). For wells where clusters cover LESS than about half of the well floor. Default for new images. Evaluated on 11 real images (docs/EVALUATION.md); not validated against researcher masks.

adaptive_filled.description: Same as adaptive_sparse, but the floor level is estimated from the lightest 25% of the well, for wells where a cluster covers MORE than about half of the floor (large / magnified spheroids). Selects too much on brightly lit pyramid wells.

adaptive_sparse_watershed.description: adaptive_sparse + watershed split of touching clusters with a narrow neck. Optional; the reviewer can re-merge pieces with Assign parts.

pyramid_bright.description: Light grey pyramidal wells, dark clusters (tuned on the OVAL example). Classical segmenter with fixed pixel thresholds: only valid at the magnification it was tuned on.

flat_floor_bright.description: Bright flat well floor with thick dark walls, large dark clusters (tuned on the YAMUK example). Classical segmenter with fixed pixel thresholds: only valid at the magnification it was tuned on.

pyramid_dark.description: Dark pyramidal wells on a bright surface (PRAMT example). Automatic results on the example were judged unreliable in the prototype review; use manual annotation. Classical segmenter with fixed pixel thresholds: only valid at the magnification it was tuned on.

cellpose.description: Fine-tuned Cellpose model (spheroid_v2, Hugging Face umutovuncsenol/sferoid). Trained on flat-well images; not for pyramid wells yet.

measurement._comment: boundary_sigma_px: Gaussian sigma for the sub-pixel boundary used by ALL measurements. envelope_radius_px: closing radius for the optional outer envelope (bridges gaps up to ~2x this).

well_detection._comment: Parameters for app/wells.py (lattice-1). Values not listed use the defaults in app/wells.py; the full parameter set used is stored with every image.
